description: This line plot illustrates the training loss curves for four different configurations during the post-training setting. The x-axis, labeled "#Iteration", represents the number of training iterations, ranging from 95,000 to 125,000 on a linear scale, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 5,000 iterations. The y-axis, labeled "Loss", represents the loss value, ranging from 2.0 to 3.0 on a linear scale, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.2. The plot includes four lines: a magenta line with circular markers and a solid line representing "SepLLM (n=64, larger lr)", which starts at a loss of approximately 3.0 and decreases to about 2.2; a blue line with circular markers and a solid line representing "SepLLM (n=128)", which starts at approximately 3.0 and decreases to about 2.3; an orange line with circular markers and a solid line representing "SepLLM (n=64)", which starts at approximately 3.0 and decreases to about 2.3; and a red dashed line representing "Vanilla before post-training", which remains constant at a loss value of 2.4 throughout the entire iteration range.
